entries.topic: The people channel added to the network map (Nov 2026): immigration and population, 1880-1948

claims.text: Clandestine immigration 1939-48 about 110,000 by sea; 66 voyages carried about 70,000; total Mandate immigration legal and illegal about 480,000.
1880 Jewish population 20,000-25,000; 650,000 at the founding of the state.
Mandate Article 6: the Administration shall facilitate Jewish immigration under suitable conditions and encourage close settlement.
1924 Act limited each country to 2% of its 1890 US residents; many European Jews turned to aliyah; Fourth Aliyah 82,000 (1924-29).
Meyerson argues the share of Jewish emigrants going to Palestine rose from about 3% to 46% (1932-39) after the US closed its doors.
